name: io.github.adamhursey/tokenbudget
title: TokenBudget
description: Sourced LLM API prices and cost budgets for agent runs across OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and more.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price one LLM request (input + expected output) on many models at once, cheapest first, with current list prices from each provider's own pricing page (source URL and check date included), prompt-cache and batch discounts, long-prompt surcharges and announced price changes. Also says whether the request fits each model's context window. Call this before an expensive request to pick a model or to stay inside a budget.

text.description: Prompt text. Counted with an estimator, never stored.

messages.description: Chat messages [{role, content}]. Counted with an estimator, never stored.

input_tokens.description: Exact input token count, if you have it. Overrides text and gives an exact cost.

output_tokens.description: Expected output tokens (or the max_tokens you will allow).

cached_input_tokens.description: How many input tokens will be read from the prompt cache.

batch.description: Price with the provider's batch API discount where one is listed.

models.description: Model ids to compare, e.g. ["claude-sonnet-5-5", "gpt-6.2-sol", "gemini-3.8-flash"]. Omit to compare every listed model. list_models gives every id.

date.description: Price on this day (YYYY-MM-DD), to see announced price changes. Default today.

tools.name: plan_agent_run
tools.description: Estimate the total cost of an agent loop that re-sends its growing context every turn, with prompt caching, on many models. Returns total cost, peak context, how many turns fit in each model's context window, how many turns fit in a budget, and a recommended model. Use before starting a long agent task.

turns.description: Number of model calls in the loop.

tools_tokens.description: Tokens of tool definitions sent every turn.

task_tokens.description: Tokens of the first user message.

cache.description: Assume prompt caching of the previous turn. Default true.

models.description: Model ids to compare, e.g. ["claude-sonnet-5-5", "gpt-6.2-sol", "gemini-3.8-flash"]. Omit to compare every listed model. list_models gives every id.

tools.name: check_context_fit
tools.description: Say which models can take this input plus the output you want to reserve, which cannot, and which do not publish a context window. Use before sending a very large document or conversation.

text.description: Prompt text. Counted with an estimator, never stored.

messages.description: Chat messages [{role, content}]. Counted with an estimator, never stored.

input_tokens.description: Exact input token count, if you have it. Overrides text and gives an exact cost.

models.description: Model ids to compare, e.g. ["claude-sonnet-5-5", "gpt-6.2-sol", "gemini-3.8-flash"]. Omit to compare every listed model. list_models gives every id.

tools.name: count_tokens
tools.description: Estimate how many tokens a text is for each tokenizer family (OpenAI o200k, Claude legacy and 2026, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen), with an error band. Estimates only; for exact counts use the provider's count endpoint.

text.description: Prompt text. Counted with an estimator, never stored.

messages.description: Chat messages [{role, content}]. Counted with an estimator, never stored.

models.description: Model ids to compare, e.g. ["claude-sonnet-5-5", "gpt-6.2-sol", "gemini-3.8-flash"]. Omit to compare every listed model. list_models gives every id.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every model this tool prices, with input, output, cache and batch prices per 1M tokens, context window, max output, source URL and the day the price was checked.

provider.description: One provider (same as providers with one item).

tools.name: get_model_pricing
tools.description: Price, context window, long-prompt surcharge, announced price changes and source for one model id.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report a wrong price, a missing model, a bug or an idea. Read by a person. Keep it under 1000 characters and do not include prompts, secrets or personal data (they are scrubbed anyway).

model.description: Model id the feedback is about, if any.

endpoint.description: Tool or endpoint the feedback is about, e.g. plan_agent_run.
